candidate profile a ph.d. in experimental particle physics or a closely related field. proven experience in high-energy physics data analysis and/or detector software and simulation. strong teamwork jobs.match_text: postdoctoral position in experimental neutrino physics postdoctoral position in experimental neutrino physics the experimental neutrino physics group at national taiwan university as the decay source and as signal detectors, achieving exceptional detection efficiency. the detectors are immersed in liquid argon (lar), which also functions as an active veto system to identify the rare decay events while minimizing background noise. at ntu, our group is developing an on-site lar facility within the department to study next-generation wavelength-shifting materials and at pin-jung.chiu@phys.ntu.edu.tw , including the following documents: · cover letter · statement of research experience and interests · detailed curriculum vitae, including a list of publications · position is filled.
